title: 格雷福斯·长街暮光
description: 格雷福斯穿完整长外套在空旷石街停步，双管枪安全朝地垂持，胡须与毛领被夕光勾出硬朗轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Graves is a broad adult man with swept dark hair, a heavy moustache and beard, thick eyebrows, and a weathered composed face. Preserve his rugged long coat, fur collar, fully covering shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and heavy boots. His distinctive large double-barreled firearm is carried low with the muzzle directed at empty ground, finger away from the trigger and no cigar or smoke.
art_direction.scene: He pauses on a broad empty harbor street, shoulders angled against a long perspective of plain building fronts and distant water. One hand rests naturally at his belt while the lowered firearm stays clear of his legs. Hard sunset and deep navy shadow divide coarse wax-crayon coat shapes, giving the complete still figure weight without confrontation or a target.
art_direction.palette: charcoal brown, dark navy, fur ivory, copper sunset
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
